The '''twenchok''' was an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Octopus/Legends|octopus]]-like [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] native to the water world of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It had eight [[Limb|tentacles]], four of which it used to move across land. It also had four [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], spaced around the top of its head. Though normally [[Color/Legends|black]], it could camouflage itself to sneak up on prey. It was equipped with a defense mechanism that shot [[Quill/Legends|quills]] that could be discharged singly or in volleys; if attacked, it would retreat while firing these. At least one twenchok was able to sneak into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-A-761 Oceanic Garrison|aquatic garrison]] on Sedri.<ref name="BGS" />
